scope: External NLSY97 replication of primary H1-H6 finite-cohort experiments; retrospective original event-history archive
feature_employment_rule: last fully completed week before interview month; origin first Sunday after interview month end
education_role: grouping only, round-specific archival interview value
employment_yes: employer roster UID >=9701 and <1000000; any unexpected positive code remains unresolved

H1.comparison: C0/C1 on initial information; C1_same_audit and C3 on identical 50 paid audit labels; all 3 horizons

H3.response_bias: reverse estimated answer probabilities, clipped to [0.05,0.95]
H3.Gamma_bound_scope: integer outer envelope floor(lower*M), ceil(upper*M) for hidden prevalence odds relative to visible prevalence; evaluate premise separately
H3.natural_unknowns: C1 and profile only; no true regret claimed

H4.selection: stable hash of respondent ID, among complete paths and employed lag state
H4.query_gain: minimax over unknown answers, never oracle point gain
H4.monthly_weekly_extension: descriptive schema/path preservation only; not an additional confirmatory outcome

H5.empty_group_policy: report as not represented, never claim evidence for it; normalize only nonempty finite groups
H5.scenario: uniform 20% versus doubled missing probability in youngest observed age group

H6.frozen_model: same h1 model from pre2014 training throughout

confirmation_policy: No parameter selection from confirmation outputs; software corrections must be logged separately
limits: not a universal proof of superiority
only public-use observed archive truth in controlled tests
no claim of historical deployment feature vintage
NLSY97 age range differs from RLMS
external primary replication does not equal reimplementation of all author-paper baselines
